name: github_list_repos
description: List the repos in the connected source control account. Call this when the user asks what repos are available, or before opening one.

name: github_open_repo
description: Open a repo in the code panel so the user can browse its files. The panel shows the root file tree.

repo.description: repo id (owner/name) or just the repo name

name: github_open_file
description: Open a specific file from the current repo in the code panel. The user sees the file with syntax colouring.

path.description: file path in the repo, e.g. src/main.py

name: github_list_prs
description: List the open pull requests on the current repo. Shows each PR's number, title, author and change size. Call before github_show_pr.

name: github_show_pr
description: Show a pull request as a diff in the code panel. The panel switches to PR view: changed files on the left, the unified diff on the right. Push and merge always need the user to confirm through you — never do it silently.

name: github_close_pr
description: Close the PR diff view and go back to the file browser.
